_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Do not fear, soil and seed; be glad and rejoice.
The Lord has done great things.
The threshing floors are full of grain.
The vats overflow with wine and oil.
Those who sowed in tears
come home singing, carrying the sheaves.
Come, let us worship with full hands.
The Lord has done great things for us. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Do not be afraid, O soil; be glad and rejoice, for the early rains have come and the threshing floors are heavy with grain.
The Lord has done great things for us.
Those who went out weeping, carrying the seed, are coming home with shouts of joy, their arms full of sheaves.
The Lord has done great things for us.
Look at the birds: they neither sow nor reap, and your Father feeds them. Are you not worth more than they?
The Lord has done great things for us.
So seek first the kingdom, set down your worry, and come to the harvest table with thanks.
The Lord has done great things for us, and we are glad. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Be glad, O soil; the rains have come.
We are filled with joy.
The barns are full, the vats overflow.
We are filled with joy.
Those who sowed in tears come home singing.
We are filled with joy.
Come, seek first the kingdom and give thanks.
The Lord has done great things for us. Amen.
